intent_summary: Analysis applies cooperative resource limits and exposes partial or failed results without discarding valid earlier or sibling evidence.

criteria.criterion: A method failure preserves evidence completed before the failure and reports the error.
criteria.notes: The failure regression preserves evidence through index 44 and reports the injected error at index 45.

criteria.criterion: Runtime budgets are checked cooperatively and produce an explicit stop reason.
criteria.notes: Cooperative target/sample checks expose runtime_budget and budget_exceeded; this is not a hard process timeout.

criteria.criterion: CLI byte limits and execution failures produce distinct error exits.
criteria.notes: The full suite executed the byte-limit and execution-exit regression successfully; invalid input exits 2 and execution failure exits 1.

criteria.criterion: A failed dataset or relationship leaves healthy sibling results available and marks the overall run partial.
criteria.notes: Healthy dataset evidence survives target-specific failure; inspected incomplete-usage reports partial with no invented healthy relationship.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
Executed and inspected CLI examples, time preparation, policy replay, open-day monitoring, and MCP conversion evidence drilldown; .capabilities/reviews/deliverable-lanes/manual-checks.json.
